nodes.description: Public mapping(address=>uint) balanceOf holding token balances of holders.
Public nested mapping allowance[owner][spender] used for delegated transfers.
Private mapping _onSaleNum counting how many sell operations an address performed.
Private mapping canSale controlling which addresses bypass the sale restrictions.
Private uint _minSale minimum amount accepted while sale is active.
Private uint _maxSale maximum amount accepted while sale is active.
Private uint _saleNum maximum number of sells allowed per address.
Address tradeAddress whitelisted by the owner for transfers.
Private address owner, privileged account used for access control checks.
Public uint totalSupply of the token.
Constant Uniswap V2 router address 0x7a25...488D used in whitelisting.
Public string name of the token.
Public string symbol of the token.
Public constant uint decimals = 18 used in supply math.
Public payable transfer(address,uint) that delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
Public payable transferFrom(address,address,uint) performing allowance and balance updates with raw arithmetic.
Public payable approve(address,uint) writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view ensure(address,address,uint) whitelist gate checking owner, UNI, tradeAddress and canSale before condition().
Internal view condition(address,uint) enforcing _saleNum/_minSale/_maxSale limits.
Public payable delegate(address,bytes) that owner-guards and then performs an arbitrary delegatecall.
Public owner-only init(uint,uint,uint) configuring sale limits with unchecked scaling math.
Public payable owner-only batchSend(address[],uint) distributing tokens with unchecked arithmetic.
Public owner-only setTradeAddress(address) updating the tradeAddress whitelist.
Internal pure pairFor(factory,tokenA,tokenB) computing a Uniswap pair address via keccak256.
Payable constructor setting name, symbol, supply, owner, initial balance and UNI allowance.
msg.sender: attacker-controlled caller used as owner check, allowance owner and _from in transferFrom.
Low-level delegatecall to a user-supplied address with user-supplied calldata, executing arbitrary code on this contract.
Unchecked native arithmetic in transferFrom: allowance[from][sender] -= value, balanceOf[from] -= value, balanceOf[to] += value.
Unchecked native arithmetic in batchSend: total = _value * _tos.length, balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total, balanceOf[_to] += _value.
Unchecked multiplication token*(10**uint256(decimals)) and maxToken*(10**uint256(decimals)) in init.

edges.reason: transfer forwards its arguments to transferFrom with msg.sender as _from.
msg.sender is used as _from and as the spender whose allowance is decremented in transferFrom.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] using the caller as owner.
delegate is protected only by require(msg.sender == owner).
init is protected only by require(msg.sender == owner).
batchSend is protected only by require(msg.sender == owner).
setTradeAddress is protected only by require(msg.sender == owner).
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and mints the whole supply to the caller.
transferFrom calls ensure(_from,_to,_value) before mutating balances.
transfer reaches ensure indirectly through transferFrom.
ensure falls back to require(condition(_from,_value)) for non-whitelisted senders.
ensure compares _from and _to against the owner state variable for the whitelist bypass.
ensure compares _from against tradeAddress.
ensure reads canSale[_from] to bypass the sale restriction.
ensure whitelists the hardcoded UNI router address and the derived pair.
condition reads _saleNum to cap the number of sells per address.
condition reads _minSale to enforce the minimum transfer amount.
condition reads _maxSale to enforce the maximum transfer amount.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] to compare against _saleNum.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] with raw subtraction, allowing underflow if the check is bypassed or state is inconsistent.
transferFrom applies balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value with unchecked native arithmetic.
transferFrom reaches the unchecked allowance/balance arithmetic block.
batchSend reaches the unchecked multiplication and balance update block.
batchSend modifies balanceOf entries in a loop without SafeMath.
init reaches the unchecked amount scaling arithmetic.
init writes _minSale.
init writes _maxSale.
init writes _saleNum.
delegate performs an arbitrary delegatecall to parameter a with parameter b as calldata, guarded only by the owner check.
The delegatecall executes external code in the context of this contract, creating a callback path back into the token's state.
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress whitelist variable.
approve overwrites allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
constructor sets totalSupply from _supply scaled by decimals.
constructor initializes balanceOf[msg.sender] with the whole supply.
constructor grants uint(-1) allowance to the UNI router address.

Parameter token is scaled with unchecked multiplication in init.
Parameter maxToken is scaled with unchecked multiplication in init.
Parameter _tos controls the loop length and the unchecked total computation in batchSend.
Parameter _value is multiplied and added to balances unchecked in batchSend.
Parameter addr is written into tradeAddress by setTradeAddress.
Parameter _name initializes state name in the constructor.
Parameter _symbol initializes state symbol in the constructor.
Parameter _supply is scaled with unchecked multiplication in the constructor.
Local total = _value * _tos.length is computed with unchecked multiplication.
Local _UNI is computed inside ensure and compared against _from.
Local pair is the return value derived in pairFor.
Local token0 is ordered inside pairFor.
Local token1 is ordered inside pairFor.
Loop index i drives the recipient loop in batchSend.
